admin.task_buttons_also_use_creation_loc: Task buttons also use creation locks and idempotency keys; repeated clicks do not create duplicate sessions.
admin.tag_categories_include_primary_kno: Tag categories include primary knowledge, supporting knowledge, methods, task types, structures, constraints, and custom tags.
admin.bank_export_creates_utf_8_question: Bank export creates UTF-8 question_bank_transfer_v1 JSON containing schema_version, exported_at, filters, table_counts, and tables.
admin.bank_import_accepts_only_platform_: Bank import accepts only platform-exported question_bank_transfer_v1 JSON, not raw enriched JSON. Use Import bundled JSON for the five original enriched sources and the GPT6-organized AI source.
admin.validate_the_package_first_for_a_f: Validate the package first for a full dry-run check and counts without database writes, then import if there are no issues.
admin.import_merges_by_primary_key_and_m: Import merges by primary key and maps source_files by filename and hash. Equal filenames with different hashes remain separate sources.
admin.diagnostics_exclude_api_keys_encry: Diagnostics exclude API keys, encrypted settings, complete provider requests/responses, full learner free text, and full questions.
admin.copy_the_degraded_identifier_from_: Copy the degraded identifier from the status bar. The Diagnostics button opens Admin so you can export a package and provide the identifier to a maintainer.
admin.health_details_group_liveness_read: Health details group liveness, readiness, degradation, and diagnostics. They check only local API, database, disk, release, and provider configuration, without external model calls or exposing keys.
admin.runtime_configuration_shows_backen: Runtime configuration shows backend version, defaults, configured settings, feature flags, and whether secrets are configured. API keys never appear in plaintext.
admin.cost_hints_show_call_volume_and_us: Cost hints show call volume and use the Admin price table for local planning. An empty table uses generic estimates, not official provider prices.
admin.real_ai_runs_recheck_recorded_toke: Real AI runs recheck recorded token costs. Reaching a daily/monthly budget stops the task unless overrun was confirmed, with the reason recorded.
admin.configuration_snapshots_retain_can: Configuration snapshots retain candidates, examples, concurrency, reuse, provider, stars, and tags. In-flight calls may incur costs after interruption, but late results will not publish.
admin.parallel_candidates_receive_differ: Parallel candidates receive different design contracts covering task format, presentation, methods, condition structure, story domain, and numerical structure.
admin.saved_api_keys_remain_only_in_encr: Saved API keys remain only in encrypted backend settings. The frontend input clears and does not display plaintext afterward.
admin.the_admin_quality_suite_helps_asse: The Admin quality suite helps assess prompt, model, and provider changes before continued use or release.
admin.exports_exclude_api_keys_re_enter_: Exports exclude API keys. Re-enter a key in model settings on a new computer.
admin.do_not_clear_real_usage_data_casua: Do not clear real usage data casually. Use export/import if you are concerned about upgrades.
admin.the_release_includes_the_api_execu: The release includes the API executable, web runtime, Node, bank background material, and launcher; it also works on computers with Python installed.
admin.if_ports_are_occupied_inspect_chec: If ports are occupied, inspect check.cmd, then use stop.cmd to stop only this release's API/Web processes.
admin.targeted_retries_turn_duplication_: Targeted retries turn duplication, inconsistent answers, difficulty, and style failures into constraints. Each retry root allows at most 3 retries, never unlimited provider calls.
admin.errors_include_a_user_message_code: Errors include a user message, code, next step, and degraded identifier. Copy degraded and export diagnostics to trace stuck requests or provider calls.
admin.if_the_page_will_not_open_services: If the page will not open, services may be stopped or ports occupied. Run START_HERE.cmd, then check.cmd to inspect API and Web status.
admin.missing_expert_star_calibration_ca: Missing expert star-calibration cases and model comparison
admin.star_calibration_cases_are_availab: Star-calibration cases are available; model evaluation is pending
admin.value_timed_out_value_seconds_refr: {0} timed out ({1} seconds). Refresh status, retry, or cancel the current task.
admin.the_page_is_open_checking_whether_: The page is open; checking whether the backend API is ready.
admin.local_api_is_starting_or_blocked_b: Local API is starting or blocked by the system
admin.on_first_launch_allow_windows_secu: On first launch, allow Windows Security/firewall prompts. Recovery usually takes 30-120 seconds. You can also select Check again.
admin.backend_ready_api_key_status_is_sh: Backend ready. API key status is shown live in the status bar.
admin.the_page_is_open_but_cannot_reach_: The page is open but cannot reach the API. If this persists, run START_HERE or restart with the launcher's stop/start commands.
admin.opened_admin_export_diagnostics_an: Opened Admin. Export diagnostics and include the previous degraded identifier when reporting the issue.
admin.no_current_or_historical_tasks_try: No current or historical tasks. Try Repair stuck states if needed. If the API disconnects, use dist\math-platform\launcher\MathPlatform.exe stop, then start.
admin.starting_today_s_task_do_not_click: Starting today's task; do not click again
admin.fill_task_queued_currently_value_v: Fill task queued: currently {0}/{1}; cancel in Task center
admin.interrupt_valuevalue_value_in_flig: Interrupt {0}{1} {2}? In-flight model calls may finish, but no new questions will be dispatched.
admin.testing_api_key_and_default_model: Testing API key and default model
admin.clear_the_saved_backend_api_key_re: Clear the saved backend API key? Real AI calls will become unavailable; mock workflows will still work.
admin.bank_validation_complete_value_que: Bank validation complete: {0} questions to import{1}
admin.model_settings_saved_locally_defau: Model settings saved locally: default {0}, {1} roles use the selected models for real calls. Settings survive restarts.
admin.model_settings_saved_default_value: Model settings saved: default {0}, but no API key configured
admin.open_admin_to_export_redacted_diag: Open Admin to export redacted diagnostics
admin.api_key_saved_real_models_are_avai: API key saved; real models are available.
admin.api_ready_no_api_key_saved_yet: API ready; no API key saved yet.
admin.global_ai_concurrency_and_provider: global AI concurrency and provider rate limits
admin.prices_are_usd_per_1_000_tokens_su: Prices are USD per 1,000 tokens. Supports model, provider:model, and provider:default. Blank uses generic built-in estimates, not actual LiaoBots prices.
admin.blank_adds_no_restriction_supports: Blank adds no restriction. Supports model, provider:model, provider:*, *, or a JSON array. Unlisted reviewers block strict real-AI publication unless degradation is explicitly accepted.
admin.each_prompt_version_records_input_: Each prompt version records input/output schemas, required model capabilities, evaluation baselines, and mock status. Activate can roll a role back; subsequent calls use it immediately.
admin.use_the_current_real_ai_api_and_lo: Use the current real AI API and log fixed quality-case results
admin.without_an_api_key_the_backend_fai: Without an API key, the backend fails closed instead of silently using mocks
admin.health_checks_cover_liveness_readi: Health checks cover liveness, readiness, degradation, and diagnostics. They inspect local database, disk, release manifest, and provider configuration without external model calls or exposing keys.
admin.load_layered_health_status_for_the: Load layered health status for the API, database, disk, provider settings, and release manifest.
admin.shows_backend_configuration_versio: Shows backend configuration version, defaults, configured values, and feature flags. API keys show configured status only; full keys remain in the backend.
admin.load_defaults_explicit_settings_se: Load defaults, explicit settings, secret configuration status, and feature flags.
admin.search_states_descriptions_or_mode: Search states, descriptions, or model fields
admin.retry_limit_reached_no_more_provid: Retry limit reached; no more provider calls.
admin.includes_configuration_summaries_d: Includes configuration summaries, database integrity, table counts, failed jobs/batches, redacted audit logs, and AI-call summaries. Excludes API keys, ciphertext, complete provider payloads, full learner text, and full questions.
admin.api_web_dependency_summaries_do_no: API/Web dependency summaries do not match. Rebuild the dependencies and regenerate the manifest.
admin.some_data_could_not_be_synchronize: Some data could not be synchronized. Use Check again or Refresh all. Existing data and API keys have not been cleared.
admin.api_key_status_could_not_be_loaded: API key status could not be loaded. Use Check again; this does not mean the key is missing.
admin.loading_model_settings_api_key_sta: Loading model settings; API key status is not known yet.
admin.the_job_is_calling_a_provider_vali: The job is calling a provider, validating JSON, or reviewing candidates.
admin.a_provider_validation_database_or_: A provider, validation, database, or unhandled error caused the job to fail.
admin.star_calibration_cases_are_availab: Star-calibration cases are available; model evaluation is pending
admin.enter_a_complete_api_base_url_incl: Enter a complete API base URL, including https://.
admin.saving_timed_out_recheck_the_local: Saving timed out. Recheck the local service and reopen API setup before retrying; the save may have completed.
admin.this_provider_returned_no_models_c: This provider returned no models. Check its URL, key permissions and /models support.
admin.the_model_did_not_return_a_valid_r: The model did not return a valid reply.
admin.stopped_waiting_a_request_already_: Stopped waiting. A request already sent to the provider may still be billed. No settings were saved.
admin.include_v1_if_required_by_your_pro: Include /v1 if required by your provider. Do not paste a website login address.
admin.no_search_matches_your_selected_mo: No search matches. Your selected model is retained.
admin.use_this_model_for_all_ai_roles_an: Use this model for all AI roles and star levels
admin.your_key_is_saved_by_this_local_ap: Your key is saved by this local app only after you click Save. Reopen this dialog using API setup at the top of the page.
